name: smwmusic-maarten-bywaard-the-last-night
title: Maarten Bywaard - The Last Night
description:
The Last Night by Maarten Bywaard.

This song was used in Donut and I's VLDC13 level, Sapphire Shores. When I originally ported this, I didn't have enough experience to make this song fully SMW compatible, but after revisiting it a couple of days ago, I managed to do it (somewhat).
Huge thanks to Ahrion for helping with the samples back then, love you man.

Make sure to insert the sample group included in the submission.
Omits Thunder, @15 (Yoshi) and @7 (Bonus End).
